answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 30301 Country: India Title: Is neyaz, fatiha imporatant or compulsary or has any relavance in islam? Question: is neyaz, fatiha imporatant or compulsary or has any relavance in islam? Answer ID: 30301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 323/235/L=1432) Niyaz fatiha is not proved from Shariah. It is baseless and innovation. قراء الفاتحة والإخلاص والكافرون على الطعام بدعة (فتاوى سمرقندى) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
